understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to solve each level by moving the selectable piece(s) so that every goal tile marked with a '+' is occupied by a selectable simultaneously, progressing through all levels until the game reports WIN.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each MOVE action shifts the currently selected piece by one grid cell (3 pixels) in the chosen direction unless blocked by walls or other objects; some adjacent objects are pushable and can be moved along if pushed. Walls/boundaries can prevent movement, though the movement_blocked hints are only heuristic and don’t guarantee success/failure. If multiple selectables exist, CLICK on another selectable’s exact pixel-coordinate position switches which piece is controlled.

understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to solve each level by moving the selectable piece(s) so that every goal tile marked with a '+' is occupied by a selectable simultaneously, progressing through all levels until the game reports WIN.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each MOVE action shifts the currently selected piece by one grid cell (3 pixels) in the chosen direction unless blocked by walls or other objects; some adjacent objects are pushable and can be moved along if pushed. Walls/boundaries can prevent movement, though the movement_blocked hints are only heuristic and don’t guarantee success/failure. If multiple selectables exist, CLICK on another selectable’s exact pixel-coordinate position switches which piece is controlled.
